how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).
Submit the duly filled form with complete information regarding educational qualifications including percentage of marks/division, details of work experience etc.
Send by e-mail with advertisement No. on the subject line to Prof. Vipin Kumar at email id: [email protected].
Email it on or before 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 10th Pass + ITI Diploma (01 or 02 years) candidates with relevant experience in a research lab will be given priority. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Jr. Project Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 30 October 2026. There is no online form.

faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years.

faq.answer: Rs.24,300 p.m. (Consolidated).

faq.answer: 10th Pass + ITI Diploma with relevant experience in a research lab.

faq.answer: Yes. 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST Candidates.

faq.answer: Shortlisting based on qualifications. Online interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed for online interview.

faq.answer: Appointment is contractual with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or for a maximum period of three years, whichever is earlier.
